capabilities: Switch to a random community theme on demand
Rotate themes automatically on startup, daily, or weekly
Mark themes Love or Skip to shape future picks
Download uninstalled themes into .obsidian/themes before applying
Clear cached downloaded themes while keeping loved ones
extras: Makes network requests to raw.githubusercontent.com to fetch the community theme list and download theme CSS and manifest files; the README states no other data is sent or collected. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian applies themes only when you pick them manually, so trying many community themes means installing, switching, and uninstalling them by hand.
summary: Theme rotation plugin that applies a different community theme daily, weekly, or on startup, downloading and installing it first when needed.
